data.title: Mansio at Th8
data.about:
Explore the distinctive charm of Mansio at Th8 Palm Jumeirah, an exquisite residential offering by IFA Hotels & Resorts. This elite complex showcases a diverse selection of living spaces, including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom Mansio serviced apartments, alongside grand penthouses and expansive townhouses. Each unit is thoughtfully furnished and meticulously serviced, presenting a supreme choice for a sophisticated second home or an extraordinary pied-à-terre for discerning international buyers.

Mansio at Th8 is a beacon of elegance and style, drawing inspiration from the glamorous and upscale atmosphere of South Beach, Miami. Residents at Mansio at Th8 Palm Jumeirah enjoy a lavish beachfront lifestyle, complete with first-rate amenities and facilities. The development's location on the West Crescent offers panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and iconic Dubai landmarks such as the Dubai Marina, The Atlantis, The Burj Al Arab, and Ain Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: Discover Mansio Furnished Apartments at The Palm
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Advanced hotel management services with remote access, security, and utility management.
  • Optional Rental Management Pool for flexible investment options.
  • Personalized temperature control systems in each unit.
  • Elegantly fully furnished interiors.
  • Premium finishes throughout, including marble floors.
  • Private balconies and terraces for exclusive outdoor space.
  • High-end, Italian branded kitchen appliances.
  • In-residence laundry facilities.
  • Spacious, fully fitted closets and cabinetry.
  • Luxurious marble finishes in bathrooms.
  • Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows.
  • Versatile layouts with lock-off options.
  • Convenient underground and valet parking.
  • Tailored a-la-carte services for residents.

location_tile.title: Situated in world-famous Palm Jumeirah
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Palm Jumeirah, known as the most famous island worldwide, stands as a symbol of luxury and exclusivity. This magnificent destination boasts an unparalleled assortment of opulent villas, townhouses, apartments, and hotels. Architecturally designed in the shape of a palm tree, including a trunk, a crescent, and 16 fronds, it is majestically positioned along the Arabian Sea coast. Mansio at Th8 enhances this prestigious locale by offering its residents and guests an epitome of refined living. Situated beachfront, it provides access to top-tier amenities and facilities, complemented by endless vistas of the Arabian Gulf. Located on the West Crescent, Mansio at Th8 presents breathtaking panoramic views of the Dubai Marina skyline, The Atlantis, The Burj Al Arab, and Ain Dubai.

  • Imperial Beach Club 1.5km
  • Aquaventure Waterpark 2.4km
  • Nakheel Mall 4.1km
  • Redwood Montessori Nursery 5.4km
  • Dubai Marina Mall 11km
  • Burj Arab 12.6km
  • DXB Airport 36km
